name: Book swap
description: A blue cloth hardback with a photocopied tick-box slip sticking out of the top as a bookmark: a marker-drawn header bar and two boxes ticked in red pen beside dotted lines, with a little photocopier grain.
choices: The swap letter that travelled with every disk becomes the note tucked into a lent book: what you thought of it, in tick boxes
Photocopier black on warm white and red pen on the slip; the book is plain cloth with a stamped panel, and no words are typed
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
